---
title: "Boxplot"
description: "Create customizable multi-group boxplots with pairwise statistical annotations."
---

## Input format

Upload an `.xlsx` table in **wide format**, with one quantitative group per column. The module uses the column names as group labels.

## Workflow

1. Upload the Excel file.
2. Select the groups to display.
3. Choose pairwise comparisons.
4. Set x- and y-axis labels.
5. Customize group colors, box width, point size and outline color.
6. Choose a ggplot theme.
7. Review the statistical annotations.
8. Set output width/height and download the figure as PDF.

The current boxplot workflow uses pairwise **t-tests** via `ggpubr::stat_compare_means`.

::: {.callout-important}
A t-test assumes an appropriate design and distributional model. Do not apply independent pairwise t-tests to paired/repeated-measures data without accounting for pairing, and consider multiple-testing correction when many comparisons are shown.
:::
